discription: A warm pad sound using a pulse oscillator with a resonant low-pass filter, featuring a slowly varying pulse width.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.5, 1.0, 0.7, 2.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var pulseWidth = SinOsc.kr(0.1).range(0.1, 0.9);    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth);    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
